Name: Processing Information TRE
Description: The Processing Information TRE (CSPROA) identifies processing options that were applied during image formation.  The CSPROA TRE is a required TRE that resides in image segment subheaders.  If the data for a given sensor (sub-image) spans multiple image segments, the CSPROA TRE shall be identical in each of the image segments and shall represent information for the entire sub-image.

RESERVED_0.Name: RESERVED 0
RESERVED_0.Description: This field only contains the value of 'LATESTCAL'.

RESERVED_1.Name: RESERVED 1
RESERVED_1.Description: This field is only filled with space characters.

RESERVED_2.Name: RESERVED 2
RESERVED_2.Description: This field is only filled with space characters.

RESERVED_3.Name: RESERVED 3
RESERVED_3.Description: This field only contains the value of 'MARKANDFIX'.

RESERVED_4.Name: RESERVED 4
RESERVED_4.Description: This field is only filled with space characters.

RESERVED_5.Name: RESERVED 5
RESERVED_5.Description: This field contains the value 'CORR' for MS and all spaces for Pan.

RESERVED_6.Name: RESERVED 6
RESERVED_6.Description: This field only contains the value of 'SKIPAGM'.

RESERVED_7.Name: RESERVED 7
RESERVED_7.Description: This field only contains the value of 'INTERP'.

RESERVED_8.Name: RESERVED 8
RESERVED_8.Description: This field is only filled with space characters.

BWC.Name: Bandwidth Compression
BWC.Description: This field contains one of the following three values: VISUAL = JPEG 2000 visually lossless, NUMERICAL = JPEG 2000 numerically lossless, UNCOMPRESSED = no compression.
